brief:
The UN special rapporteur on Palestinian human rights, Francesca Albanese, invoked the Nuremberg trials in response to statements by Israeli model Saray Givati regarding the killing of Palestinians in Gaza, Shehab Wire reported. Albanese rejected characterizations of Palestinian children as terrorists or future militants, drawing parallels to how Nazi defendants were judged at Nuremberg.

The remarks came as part of broader international scrutiny over rhetoric used to justify military operations in Gaza and treatment of Palestinian civilians, particularly children.
